pages.title: Integrator
pages.text: A mechanical differential analyser: wheels and discs that add up a rate, step by step, into what it amounts to.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the step size h and the method's order m (1 Euler, 2 midpoint, 4 Runge-Kutta). The error, about (hk)^(m+1)/(m+1), must be under the recipe's tolerance; past hk = 2 (2.785 for order 4) the steps blow up. Bigger steps are faster; higher orders cost more per step.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Imaginary Unit, Rate Table, Stability Margin, e Crystal.
